title: PNP seizes P43.27-M shabu, arrests Romanian national at Naia

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Around P43.27 million worth of suspected shabu, or methamphetamine hydrochloride, brought by a Romanian national was seized by authorities at the Ninoy Aquino International Airport (Naia) in Pasay City, according to the Philippine National Police (PNP). The alleged illegal drugs were discovered in the luggage of a 65-year-old foreign national, Florin Pavel, during airport inspection on Monday, Nov. 16.
